\newlength{\maxlen}
\newcommand{\databar}[3][green!25]{%
  \settowidth{\maxlen}{#3}%
  \addtolength{\maxlen}{\tabcolsep}%
  \FPeval\result{round(#2/#3:4)}%
  \rlap{\color{green!25}\hspace*{-.5\tabcolsep}\rule[-.05\ht\strutbox]{\result\maxlen}{.95\ht\strutbox}}%
  \makebox[\dimexpr\maxlen-\tabcolsep][r]{#2}%
}

\newcommand*\partialcircle[1][0.85ex]{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[fill=green!70] (0,0)-- (90:#1) arc (90:270:#1) -- cycle ;
  \draw (0,0) circle (#1);
  \end{tikzpicture}}

\newcommand*\threequartercircle[1][0.85ex]{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \draw[fill=green!70] (0,0) -- (90:#1) arc (90:360:#1) -- cycle;
    \draw (0,0) circle (#1);
  \end{tikzpicture}%
}

        #2
    \end{tcolorbox}
}
